snippet.title: "Picross : Juufuutei Raden's Guide for Pixel Museum" Trailer (Nintendo Switch)
snippet.description:
Solve the puzzle and complete the art!
"Pixel Puzzle" that lets you experience art and culture with Juufuutei Raden.
